title: Manual Liquid Pump – Drill-Driven Suction & Transfer Pump
descriptionHtml:
Move liquid fast – with your drill

Emptying a tank or moving water by hand is slow and messy. Often more ends up on the ground than where you want it.

Hook it up to the drill and go

The pump is powered by your regular drill and moves water or fuel quickly. It also works manually and fits both EU and US threads.

Features

  • Powered by a regular drill
  • Also works manually
  • For water, fuel and other liquids
  • Fits both EU and US threads
  • Great for the garage, boat and outdoor use

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
